changeSet.author: security-audit
changeSet.comment: Bump PIN minimum from 4 to 6 digits (H-5). Any existing 4-digit PIN can no longer be verified by the new validators, so we proactively invalidate them and force users to re-set via /pin/setup/request -> /pin/setup/confirm. Pre-prod safe.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE users SET pin_hash = NULL, pin_enabled = false, pin_failures = 0, pin_locked_until = NULL, token_version = token_version + 1 WHERE pin_enabled = true OR pin_hash IS NOT NULL;
